VIX marginally compressed to ~18.41 (from 18.89 June 26 close) — still 1.41 pts above the 17 gate. DXY eased to 101.27 (from 101.25 — essentially flat). SPX 7,354 — 106 pts below the 7,460 floor. The reconstitution failure signal from June 26 is the dominant technical read heading into Monday: $334B in passive buying produced a lower close — that distribution narrative is unchanged over the weekend.

The $29.4B offering (17.79M new shares) would be the largest ADR offering in history if fully subscribed, surpassing Alibaba's $21.8B 2014 IPO. This validates SK Hynix's HBM4 supply chain (58% market share in a sold-out 2026 HBM market) and by extension confirms NVDA's Vera Rubin Blackwell GPU platform demand from the primary memory supplier. The ADR timing (July 10 listing, July 29 new shares) provides a structural demand catalyst for SK Hynix that may stabilize the HBM supply chain narrative before NVDA's Q2 FY27 earnings (~Aug 26, $91B guidance). This is a structural positive for NVDA's long-term demand thesis — not a near-term price catalyst before June 29.

analysis:
## Technical analysis (Saturday June 27 — weekend review)

**No trading June 27 (Saturday).** All levels and signals carry forward from the June 26 confirmed close.

**Stop Day 1 status:** $192.53 (June 26 close) < $195 (two-close stop threshold). Day 1 active. Day 2 = June 29 close. Two consecutive closes below $195 = mandatory full exit.

**Reconstitution failure signal (confirmed):** The June 26 $334.027B Nasdaq closing cross — the largest in exchange history — produced a lower close than the prior session. Active sellers absorbed every passive reconstitution bid. The $202.17 open is the confirmed distribution ceiling. This signal is the most bearish structural development in the current NVDA cycle and is unchanged by the weekend.

**SK Hynix ADR (positive read-through):** ADR Nasdaq July 10 listing confirmed. The supply-chain validation does not change the technical framework but strengthens the fundamental re-entry thesis post-stop.

**Regime:** SPX 7,354 (−106 pts below 7,460), VIX ~18.41 (above 17), DXY 101.27 (above 100). No weekend catalyst to clear any of the three gates. Sixth consecutive breach session.

**June 29 setup:** The binary session will be determined by Asian premarket signals (Nikkei, KOSPI reaction to SK Hynix ADR positive) and US futures at Sunday evening open. A SK Hynix ADR-driven Asia rally could provide the gap-up needed for stop reset — but this is not guaranteed.
